requestedActions.title: List the connected person's active task titles, including paginated results

guide.summary: Todoist API v1 documents user-authorized OAuth2 for connecting individual accounts. The read-only data:read scope covers tasks, and active task titles are listed through the paginated GET /api/v1/tasks endpoint.
guide.recommendation: The requested API test is not ready yet. Resolve the access mapping for List the connected person's active task titles, including paginated results. Use “Find missing request” or add official documentation beside that action.

findings.title: User-authorized OAuth2 flow for connected Todoist accounts
findings.detail: The API documents obtaining a user-authorized API token through OAuth2. Developers must register an application in the App Management Console, configure redirect URLs, and use the assigned Client ID and Client Secret in the flow.
findings.appliesWhen: Customers connect their individual Todoist accounts to the app.

evidence.quote: external applications to obtain a user authorized API token via the OAuth2
and configure one or more valid OAuth2 redirect URLs. A registered Todoist
needed for the OAuth2 flow.

findings.title: data:read grants read-only access to tasks
findings.detail: data:read grants read-only access to application data, including tasks, projects, labels, and filters. It is the least-privilege documented scope for listing active task titles and does not permit creating, updating, completing, or deleting tasks.
findings.appliesWhen: Listing the connected person's active task titles through GET /api/v1/tasks.

evidence.quote: data:read Grants read-only access to application data, including tasks, projects, labels, and filters.
https://app.todoist.com/oauth/authorize?client_id = 0123456789abcdef & scope = data:read,data:delete & state = secretstring & response_type = code

findings.title: Access tokens may expire and require refresh
findings.detail: For apps with refresh tokens enabled, the token response includes expires_in and refresh_token. Refreshing exchanges the refresh token at the token endpoint for a new access token and a rotated refresh token.
findings.appliesWhen: Apps with refresh tokens enabled, which is the default for newly created apps.

evidence.quote: applications with refresh tokens enabled (the default for newly-created apps),

refresh_token The refresh token received in the previous token exchange or refresh.

findings.title: Paginate active tasks with next_cursor
findings.detail: GET /api/v1/tasks returns results with next_cursor. Continue requesting pages with the same parameters until next_cursor is null. Cursors are not to be stored long-term.
findings.appliesWhen: Returning all active task titles, not only the first page.

steps.title: Register the Todoist OAuth app and configure a redirect URL
steps.detail: Create the application in the Todoist App Management Console, configure one HTTPS redirect URL, and record the Client ID and Client Secret. Use the confidential client method client_secret_post for the first test path.
steps.doneWhen: The app has a Client ID, a Client Secret and the redirect URL configured for the test.

steps.title: Read the first page of active task titles
steps.detail: Call GET /api/v1/tasks with the access token and limit=50. Collect $.results[].content from this page and capture next_cursor. Use no project or label filters unless requested. Boundary check: this is a read-only GET; confirm no POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE was sent and the grant is data:read only.
steps.doneWhen: HTTP 200 returned, results[].content titles collected and next_cursor captured for continuation.

steps.title: Continue paging active tasks until next_cursor is null
steps.detail: Repeat GET /api/v1/tasks with cursor set to the next_cursor from the prior response and the same limit=50, collecting $.results[].content from every page. Stop only when next_cursor is null, the documented end of results. Do not stop after two pages. Boundary check: each continuation is a read-only GET; confirm no write requests appear in the outgoing request log.
steps.doneWhen: next_cursor is null on the final response and content titles from all pages have been collected.
